newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bridge says pursues sale of company.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bridge says pursues sale of company.

text.p: Dominion Bridge said on Tuesday that it will pursue the sale of the Montreal-based company or a strategic investment in it.
Dominion said in a news release that it acted on the advice of its investment bankers, Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc, which it then instructed to immediately begin discussions with interested parties.
Dominion's board also formed a special committee of independent directors to work with Legg Mason and report to the full board.
The special panel will invite a substantial unaligned stockholder to participate in its work, Dominion said.
